attacks.name: Sand Slap
steps: |*Underfoot|: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character Pushes the defender |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Crumbling Form
superPowers.body: This character cannot pick up, hold, Contest, or Interact with objective tokens.

superPowers.name: Difficult Terrain
superPowers.body: When this character suffers |!damage| from a |!physical| attack, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.|\|Additionally, this character cannot be Thrown and does not suffer |!damage| from collisions.

superPowers.name: Dust to Dust
superPowers.body: At the end of an allied |*Sandman|'s Activation, if this character is not within |!range| 3 of it, this character is KO'd.|\|Additionally, when an allied |*Sandman| is Dazed, this character is KO'd.
